requirements.text: The system SHALL promote the exact verified artifact digest.
The system SHALL bind AI evaluation to the effective release identity.
The system SHALL halt rollout when a protected invariant fails.
The system SHALL reconcile unknown deployment outcomes before retry.
The system SHALL keep manual review available during containment and recovery.
The deployment executor SHALL reverify the stored manifest, registry artifact, current evidence, policy, and scoped authority before consuming approval.
Functional, AI, and security evaluation SHALL execute the exact packaged artifact identified by its digest.
Runtime activation SHALL resolve authenticated operation-bound observations and enforce minimum population coverage.
Recovery SHALL require incident-scoped authorization before effects and independently verify observed configuration and reconciliation evidence.
Approval requirements SHALL be selected by environment, risk tier, and affected capability and SHALL fail closed for unknown combinations.
Evaluation thresholds SHALL be derived from the approved evaluation contract revision.
Build provenance SHALL derive source revision from a clean trusted Git checkout.
